card.name: Inside Portuguese place and name words
card.fires_on: The first piece of a Portuguese or Brazilian proper name or title, where the rest of the word follows, such as Jur(éia), Peru(íbe), Rev(ista) and Moz(ambican).

modes.label: Brazilian place names
modes.description: Start of a Portuguese place name, often after 'Serra da' or 'municipalities'.
modes.example: A Flora of the Serra da<< Jur>>éia is in preparation.

modes.label: Portuguese words and surnames
modes.description: Partway through Portuguese terms or surnames in titles and citations.

card.plain: It fires inside Portuguese-language names and words, mainly Brazilian places, just before the word is completed.
